name: Full-scale invasion begins
description: Russia invades from the north, east and south, with missile strikes on cities and military sites across Ukraine.

name: Battle of Hostomel Airport
description: Russian airborne troops assault Antonov Airport to open an air bridge to Kyiv; Ukrainian forces wreck the runway.

name: Siege of Mariupol
description: Russian forces encircle and level much of Mariupol; the last defenders in the Azovstal steelworks surrender in May.

name: Battle of Kyiv
description: Russian columns push on Kyiv through Irpin and Bucha but stall, and withdraw from the north by early April.

name: Bucha massacre
description: Over 400 bodies are found in Bucha after Russia's withdrawal; many civilians were tortured and executed.

name: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant seized
description: Russian troops shell and capture Europe's largest nuclear power plant, which they still occupy.

name: Mariupol theatre airstrike
description: An airstrike hits a theatre sheltering civilians and marked 'children' outside; Amnesty called it a war crime.

name: Kramatorsk station missile strike
description: A missile with cluster munitions hits a station crowded with evacuees, killing 61 civilians.

name: Sinking of the Moskva
description: Ukrainian Neptune missiles hit the flagship of Russia's Black Sea Fleet, which sinks the next day.

name: Battle of Sievierodonetsk-Lysychansk
description: Russia takes the last cities of Luhansk oblast after weeks of artillery-heavy fighting.

name: Battle of Bakhmut
description: The war's longest battle: Wagner and Russian forces take Bakhmut at great cost after months of fighting.

name: Kherson counteroffensive
description: Ukraine cuts Russian supply lines over the Dnipro, forcing Russia out of Kherson city and the west bank.

name: Kharkiv counteroffensive
description: A rapid Ukrainian offensive retakes Balakliia, Kupiansk and Izium, collapsing Russia's front in Kharkiv oblast.

name: Strikes on the power grid
description: Waves of Russian missiles and drones target Ukraine's power plants and grid, causing blackouts through winter.

name: 2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive
description: Ukraine's push south through Zaporizhzhia oblast meets dense minefields and gains little ground.

name: Kakhovka Dam destroyed
description: The dam's collapse floods towns along the lower Dnipro and drains its reservoir; it is widely blamed on Russia.

name: Battle of Avdiivka
description: Russia takes the heavily fortified town near Donetsk after a four-month assault, its first big gain since Bakhmut.

name: Okhmatdyt children's hospital strike
description: A Russian missile hits Ukraine's largest children's hospital in Kyiv during a mass strike on the city.

name: Kursk incursion
description: Ukraine invades Russia's Kursk region, taking Sudzha; Russia, aided by North Korean troops, retakes it by spring.
